name: Potato
description: Everyday potatoes for sabzi, curries, parathas and fries. Store in a cool, dark, airy place, away from onions.

name: Baby Potato
description: Small, thin-skinned potatoes that cook whole for dum aloo, roasts and stir-fries. Keep in a cool, dry place and use within a week.

name: Red Potato
description: Red-skinned potatoes with firm flesh that holds its shape in curries, salads and roasts. Store cool and dark; do not refrigerate.

name: Onion
description: Red onions for tadka, gravies, salads and raita. Keep in a dry, ventilated basket and away from potatoes to stop sprouting.

name: White Onion
description: Mild white onions that suit salads, soups and light gravies. Store in a dry, airy spot out of direct sunlight.

name: Sambar Onion
description: Small sambar onions with a sweet, sharp flavour for sambar, kuzhambu and pickles. Store dry and loose; peel just before use.

name: Tomato
description: Tangy desi tomatoes for dal, curries, chutneys and rasam. Ripen at room temperature, then refrigerate to keep a few days longer.

name: Hybrid Tomato
description: Firm, round hybrid tomatoes that slice cleanly for salads, sandwiches and gravies. Keep at room temperature until fully ripe.

name: Cherry Tomato
description: Bite-sized tomatoes for salads, pasta and snacking. Rinse just before eating and store in the fridge once ripe.

name: Long Brinjal
description: Slender purple brinjals for bhaji, sambar and stuffed curries. Store in the vegetable drawer and use within three to four days.

name: Round Brinjal
description: Large round purple brinjals, ideal for roasting over a flame for baingan bharta. Keep in a cool place and use within a few days.

name: Green Brinjal
description: Green-skinned brinjals with a mild taste for curries, gotsu and stir-fries. Refrigerate in the crisper and use within a few days.

name: Tender Lady Finger

name: Lady Finger
description: Fresh local okra for bhindi sabzi, sambar and kurkuri bhindi. Store dry in a paper bag in the fridge and use within two to three days.

name: Carrot
description: Crunchy orange carrots for salads, poriyal, soups and pulao. Remove any tops and refrigerate in a bag to keep them firm.

name: Red Carrot
description: Juicy red Delhi carrots, a winter favourite for gajar ka halwa, kanji and salads. Refrigerate in a bag and use within a week.

name: Baby Carrot
description: Small, sweet carrots to steam, roast whole or eat raw with dips. Keep refrigerated in a covered container.

name: Cucumber
description: Local cucumbers for salads, raita and kachumber. Store in the fridge and use within a few days.

name: English Cucumber
description: Long, thin-skinned cucumbers with few seeds, good for slicing into salads and sandwiches. Refrigerate and use within four days.

name: Mini Cucumber
description: Small, crisp cucumbers that can be eaten whole as a snack or sliced into salads. Keep refrigerated.

name: Green Capsicum
description: Green bell peppers for stir-fries, pizzas, pulao and stuffed capsicum. Store unwashed in the fridge crisper.

name: Red Capsicum
description: Sweet red bell peppers that add colour to salads, pasta and grills. Refrigerate whole and use within a week.

name: Yellow Capsicum
description: Sweet yellow bell peppers for salads, wraps and stir-fries. Keep whole and refrigerated until use.

name: French Beans
description: Tender green beans for poriyal, mixed veg, fried rice and soups. Refrigerate unwashed in a bag; trim the ends before cooking.

name: Cluster Beans
description: Cluster beans for gawar ki sabzi, sambar and poriyal. Store in the fridge and remove strings before cooking.

name: Broad Beans
description: Flat broad bean pods (sem/avarekai) for sabzi, sambar and usli. Refrigerate in a bag and use within a few days.

name: Cabbage
description: Green cabbage for sabzi, coleslaw, momos and stir-fries. Keep whole and refrigerated; peel off outer leaves before use.

name: Purple Cabbage
description: Purple cabbage that adds crunch and colour to salads, slaws and wraps. Store whole in the fridge.

name: Cauliflower
description: Fresh cauliflower for aloo gobi, gobi paratha and Manchurian. Soak florets in warm salted water before cooking; refrigerate.

name: Compact Cauliflower
description: Smaller, tightly formed cauliflower heads suited to one or two meals. Wrap loosely and keep refrigerated.

name: Bottle Gourd
description: Long bottle gourd for lauki chana dal, kofta and halwa. Store in a cool place and use within a few days.

name: Round Bottle Gourd
description: Round variety of bottle gourd for sabzi, kofta and raita. Keep in a cool spot and refrigerate once cut.

name: Bitter Gourd
description: Bitter gourd for stuffed karela, fry and pitla. Salting the slices before cooking softens the bitterness. Refrigerate.

name: Small Bitter Gourd
description: Small bitter gourds, good for stuffing whole with masala. Store in the fridge and use within three days.

name: Ridge Gourd
description: Ridge gourd for turai sabzi, kootu and chutney made with the peel. Refrigerate and use within a few days.

name: Sponge Gourd
description: Smooth-skinned sponge gourd for light sabzi and dal. Peel thinly before cooking; store in the fridge.

name: Yellow Pumpkin
description: Sweet yellow pumpkin for kaddu sabzi, sambar and soups. Keep whole pieces cool; wrap and refrigerate once cut.

name: Green Pumpkin
description: Green-skinned pumpkin for khatta meetha kaddu, curries and stews. Refrigerate cut pieces wrapped.

name: Beetroot
description: Earthy beetroot for salads, poriyal, halwa and juice. Trim leaves and refrigerate in a bag.

name: Baby Beetroot
description: Small beetroots that roast or boil whole and suit salads. Keep refrigerated and scrub before cooking.

name: Radish
description: White radish for mooli paratha, sambar and salads. Wrap in paper and refrigerate; the leaves can be cooked too.

name: Red Radish
description: Small round red radishes with a peppery crunch for salads and garnishes. Refrigerate with the tops removed.

name: Sweet Potato
description: White-fleshed sweet potatoes to roast, boil for chaat or bake. Store in a cool, dry place, not in the fridge.

name: Orange Sweet Potato
description: Orange-fleshed sweet potatoes for roasting, mash and soups. Keep in a cool, dark place and use within a week.

name: Green Peas

name: Shelled Green Peas

name: Spinach

name: Amaranth Leaves

name: Fenugreek Leaves

name: Drumstick

name: Raw Banana

name: Raw Papaya

name: Kashmiri Apple
description: Crisp red apples from Kashmir for snacking, fruit chaat and salads. Refrigerate to keep them crunchy for longer.

name: Fuji Apple
description: Sweet, juicy Fuji apples with a dense crunch, good for eating fresh or in salads. Store in the fridge.

name: Granny Smith Apple
description: Tart green apples for salads, juices and baking. Keep refrigerated and away from bananas.

name: Robusta Banana
description: Robusta bananas for breakfast, shakes and snacking. Keep at room temperature and hang to slow bruising.

name: Yelakki Banana
description: Small, sweet Yelakki bananas, popular for prasad and snacking. Store at room temperature, away from direct sunlight.

name: Nendran Banana
description: Large Nendran bananas from Kerala, eaten ripe or used for chips and pazham pori. Ripen at room temperature.

name: Green Seedless Grapes
description: Sweet green seedless grapes for snacking and fruit salads. Refrigerate unwashed and rinse just before eating.

name: Black Seedless Grapes
description: Juicy black seedless grapes for snacking and juices. Keep refrigerated in a ventilated box.

name: Red Globe Grapes
description: Large, crunchy red globe grapes with seeds, good for fruit platters. Store unwashed in the fridge.

name: Banganapalli Mango

name: Alphonso Mango
description: Fragrant Alphonso mangoes with saffron-coloured flesh for eating fresh, aamras and milkshakes. Ripen at room temperature.

name: Kesar Mango
description: Sweet Kesar mangoes from Gujarat with bright orange pulp, good for aamras and desserts. Ripen at room temperature.

name: Nagpur Orange
description: Loose-skinned, juicy Nagpur oranges that peel easily for snacking and fresh juice. Store in a cool place or the fridge.

name: Kinnow
description: Juicy Kinnow mandarins from Punjab, popular for fresh juice in winter. Keep in a cool, airy spot or refrigerate.

name: Navel Orange
description: Imported seedless navel oranges with sweet segments for eating and juicing. Refrigerate to keep them fresh for longer.

name: Mosambi
description: Sweet lime for fresh juice and snacking. Store at room temperature for a few days or refrigerate for longer.

name: Premium Mosambi
description: Larger, hand-sorted sweet limes selected for juicing. Roll on the counter before cutting to get more juice.

name: Bhagwa Pomegranate
description: Bhagwa pomegranates with deep red, sweet arils for snacking, raita and salads. Store in a cool place or the fridge.

name: Ganesh Pomegranate
description: Ganesh pomegranates with soft seeds and pinkish arils, good for juice and fruit bowls. Refrigerate whole.

name: Guava
description: White-fleshed guavas to eat with a pinch of salt and chilli or slice into fruit chaat. Ripen at room temperature.

name: Pink Guava
description: Fragrant pink-fleshed guavas for eating fresh, juices and jams. Refrigerate once ripe.

name: Red Lady Papaya
description: Red Lady papaya with sweet orange-red flesh for breakfast bowls and smoothies. Ripen at room temperature, then refrigerate.

name: Papaya
description: Local ripe papaya for breakfast and fruit salads. Keep at room temperature until soft, then chill before eating.

name: Watermelon

name: Seedless Watermelon
description: Dark-skinned seedless watermelon that is easy to cube for kids and fruit bowls. Chill before serving.

name: Muskmelon
description: Fragrant kharbuja with sweet orange flesh for eating chilled or blending into milkshakes. Refrigerate once cut.

name: Cantaloupe

name: Queen Pineapple
description: Small, sweet Queen pineapple for eating fresh, juices and salads. Store upside down for a day to spread the sweetness.

name: Kew Pineapple
description: Large, juicy Kew pineapple for juice, fruit salads and pineapple sheera. Refrigerate once cut.

name: Cricket Ball Chikoo

name: Kalipatti Chikoo
description: Oval Kalipatti sapota with honey-sweet flesh. Eat when soft to the touch; refrigerate ripe fruit.

name: Indian Pear

name: Chinese Pear
description: Round, juicy Chinese pears with a crunchy, apple-like texture. Keep refrigerated.

name: Imported Pear

name: Lime
description: Juicy Indian limes for nimbu pani, dal, chaat and pickles. Store in the fridge in a bag to keep them from drying out.

name: Yellow Lemon
description: Large yellow lemons with plenty of juice and zest for drinks, dressings and baking. Refrigerate.

name: Coconut

name: Custard Apple

name: Jamun

name: Fig

name: Green Avocado

name: Green Kiwi

name: Golden Kiwi
description: Smooth-skinned golden kiwis with sweeter yellow flesh. Eat when slightly soft; keep refrigerated once ripe.

name: White Dragon Fruit

name: Red Dragon Fruit

name: Strawberry
description: Sweet strawberries for eating fresh, shakes and desserts. Refrigerate unwashed and rinse just before eating.

name: Blueberry

name: Blackberry

name: Imported Green Seedless Grapes

name: Imported Red Seedless Grapes

name: Peach
description: Fragrant peaches for eating fresh, salads and desserts. Ripen at room temperature, then refrigerate.

name: Plum

name: Nectarine

name: Cherries

name: Passion Fruit

name: Persimmon

name: Broccoli

name: Zucchini

name: Asparagus

name: Button Mushroom

name: Oyster Mushroom

name: Shiitake Mushroom

name: Romaine Lettuce

name: Celery
